blockers.description: CR-01 (Critical, 09-REVIEW.md): packages/gateway/src/process-agent-turn.ts:78-93 cold_start gate is `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM episodic_memory WHERE scope_id=$1; if cnt==='0'`. This can never be true mid-scope because episodic_memory is ONLY written by TemplateProposalWorker.onScopeClosed (graph::scope::closed subscriber) — appendEpisodicTrace has zero production callers. Combined with the `!scopeClosed` guard, memReflect (1 embedding call + 3 hybrid SQL searches with vector+BM25 CTEs) fires on EVERY agent turn for EVERY scope, not just cold_start. Directly contradicts D-10 'cold_start Reflection Track injection' intent.
blockers.workaround: none — requires a different cold_start signal. Before implementing, check 09-CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/0022-adr21-reflection-track-trigger-spec.md for the intended cold_start detection mechanism (likely: trail/scope event count from TrailReader.getScopeEvents(), or a scope-level 'first turn' flag, rather than episodic_memory row presence).
